subject: Centralized mode-aware presentation policy
decision: Mode-specific behavior must be defined through a centralized, mode-aware presentation policy rather than scattered screen-level branching.
reason: Centralization reduces divergence, improves testability, and keeps shared safety constraints consistent.
counterargument: Local branching can be faster to prototype, but it increases long-term inconsistency and maintenance risk.
revisit_condition: Revisit only if a proven architecture provides equivalent consistency and testability with lower complexity.
